notes: Repo-owned engine surface for Ready Up. This file (or the copy embedded in the shim at build time) is the only source of signatures; the CounterStrikeSharp CDN gamedata is no longer used.
Each function must match exactly once AND pass all of its identity anchors, otherwise it is treated as unresolved. Required functions failing => Ready Up disables itself at load.
After a CS2 update run: build/readyup_sigcheck <path to Valve libserver.so> gamedata/engine-surface.json
Functions with "hook": "funchook" are detoured by Ready Up; build/readyup_hookcheck verifies funchook can relocate their prologue.

Anchor types: string_ref = function body references the string via RIP-relative LEA within `window` bytes of its start; caller_string = a direct call to the function (or to a thunk that tail-jumps to it, via_thunk) is preceded within `window` bytes by a LEA of the string; global_string = the function loads a global (RIP-relative mov in its first 32 bytes) and a LEA of that global sits within `window` bytes of a LEA of the string (for leaf accessors with no strings); callee_string = a direct call in the first `window` bytes targets a function that references the string; mov_disp = a `mov r,[r+disp32]` with that displacement in the first `window` bytes (pins a struct layout to the code reading it).

vtable_indices: each slot is verified before it is patched or called: the class's primary vtable is located through its RTTI typeinfo name (rtti section), the slot target must equal `function` and/or pass `anchors`, and at runtime the live object's vptr must equal that vtable. sigcheck runs the same checks offline. A slot that fails is never patched; the features needing it disable themselves.
layouts: struct offsets that are only trusted when their `verified_by` entry (whose anchors read exactly these offsets) verifies.
Live check on a running server: `ru selftest` (console) / `.ru selftest` (admin chat); READYUP_SELFTEST_AND_QUIT=1 runs it after the first map and quits with a status file.

Host_Say.description: Host_Say(controller, CCommand&, bool teamonly, int, const char*). Detoured (chat interception).

CCSGameRules_TerminateRound.description: CCSGameRules::TerminateRound(this, float delay, RoundEndReason, ptr, uint). Detoured (warmup/practice suppression). The VPROF scope label "TerminateRound" is loaded at +0x34.

CGameEventManager_Init.description: CGameEventManager::Init(this): Reset() + LoadEventsFromFile(resource/{core,game,mod}.gameevents). Used to locate the global event manager (call-site scan), hook only as fallback.

UTIL_ClientPrintAll.description: UTIL_ClientPrintAll(int dest, const char* msg, p1..p4). Called (not hooked).

ClientPrint.description: ClientPrint(CBasePlayerController*, int dest, const char* msg, p1..p4): single-recipient reliable filter + UTIL_ClientPrintFilter. Called (not hooked). NOT the CDN 'ClientPrint' signature, which hits an unrelated constructor.

CEntityInstance_AcceptInput.description: CEntityInstance::AcceptInput(this, input, activator, caller, value, outputId). Weapon paints only.

LegacyGameEventListener.description: GetLegacyGameEventListener(CPlayerSlot) -> IGameEventListener2* (CSource1LegacyGameEventGameSystem::CServerSideClient_GameEventLegacyProxy, 16-byte stride at +0x40 of the game system; nullptr if the system is gone or slot > 63). Called (not hooked) for per-client center HTML (welcome screen). The returned object is also RTTI-checked at runtime before FireGameEvent. Anchor: the game-system global it reads is registered right next to the gameevents_dumptofile concommand (same TU).

UTIL_Remove.description: UTIL_Remove(CEntityInstance*). The anchor for g_pGameEntitySystem (`lea rax,[rip+g_pGameEntitySystem]` at +8), and called by ru_api entity_remove (match: dropped weapons in warmup).

CCSPlayer_ItemServices_GiveNamedItem.description: CCSPlayer_ItemServices::GiveNamedItem(this, const char* name, int subtype, CEconItemView* item, bool, const Vector* origin) -> CBaseEntity*: what `give` calls. ru_api player_give_item (skins.so refreshes held weapons with it: a finish only renders on a weapon created with it).

CBaseEntity_SetAbsOrigin.description: CBaseEntity::SetAbsOrigin(this, const Vector* origin): what setpos / setpos_player / ent_setpos call to move the entity (those commands need a client of their own, so they do nothing from the server console). Practice tools (.loadpos, .spawn, .back, .bot placement) only.

anchors.string: Pushed player by %.2f over %d steps (push vector: %.2f, %.2f, %.2f)
Method Entity.Move invoked with bad newValues value.

CBasePlayerController_SetPawn.description: CBasePlayerController::SetPawn(this, CBasePlayerPawn* pawn, bool, bool, bool, bool): the controller takes `pawn` as its current pawn (m_hPawn). Called (not hooked) by ru_api player_respawn with (player pawn, true, false, false, false) before CCSPlayerController::Respawn, which respawns the current pawn: a dead player who watched from the observer pawn gets the player pawn back first. Same signature and arguments as CounterStrikeSharp's; it covers the prologue's moves of the 4th and 6th arguments.

ISource2Server::GameFrame.note: 11 IAppSystem slots + 8. Patched (tick hook). The target opens a VPROF scope named "GameFrame" at +0x27.

ISource2GameClients::ClientCommand.note: 11 IAppSystem slots + 6. Patched (jointeam / chat). The target reads CCommand argc/argv at [args+0x438]/[args+0x440] (pins layouts.CCommand) and prints "Unknown command: %s".

CCSPlayerController::Respawn.note: CounterStrikeSharp CCSPlayerController_Respawn offset 276. Called (not hooked) by ru_api player_respawn after CBasePlayerController_SetPawn. The target resets the controller's per-life state (reads [this+0xad8] and [this+0xac0]), marks a field changed (CNetworkTransmitComponent::StateChanged) and tail-calls the current pawn's respawn virtual.

CBaseEntity.note: Locates the CBaseEntity vtable for the NetworkStateChanged slot check.

CCSPlayerController.note: Locates the controller vtable for the Respawn slot check (the practice fragment declares the same entry for ChangeTeam).

CGameEventManager.note: Checked on the object's vtable before any virtual call.

CSchemaSystemTypeScope.note: libserver.so type scope; checked before FindDeclaredClass (vtbl 2).

CServerSideClient_GameEventLegacyProxy.note: Per-client listener returned by LegacyGameEventListener; checked before FireGameEvent.

CSource2GameClients.note: Source2GameClients001; its vptr must equal this vtable before ClientCommand is patched.

CSource2Server.note: Source2Server001; its vptr must equal this vtable before GameFrame is patched.

CCommand.note: CUtlVectorFixedGrowable<char*, 64> m_Args: m_Size at +0x438, m_Memory.m_pMemory (char**) at +0x440. Only trusted when the ClientCommand slot (whose code reads exactly these offsets) verifies.
